evaluations.title: Fixed-string search with equivalent output
evaluations.summary: On these four synthetic warm-cache Linux workloads, ripgrep had lower median time on selective and no-match searches; dense-output timings overlapped. Complete outputs and exit codes matched an independent oracle in every run.
limitations: One shared Linux container; scheduler load, CPU quota, filesystem and caching can change results.
Synthetic plain-text workloads with no symlinks, binary data, regular expressions, encoding conversion or real repository ignore policy.
Exact installed versions and executable hashes are recorded; results do not compare every current release or platform.
No RAM, energy, security, accessibility, cold-cache or universal speed ranking is measured.
